note: Saw this and thought of you: a photo of a young woman smiling at you like a friend, then a verse card with a line in our words. Our lines never claim to be Scripture and never put words in God's mouth.
style: Candid close-up lifestyle photograph with the polish of a top lifestyle influencer's feed: shot by a friend on an 85mm lens at eye level, shallow depth of field, warm golden-hour light, glowing skin, rich natural colors, subtle film grain, a real joyful moment caught mid-laugh, photorealistic. She is stunning, in their early twenties, with model-level natural beauty: full glossy lips, bright pearly-white smiles, big expressive eyes with long lashes and softly defined brows, flawless glowing skin with polished natural makeup, and big, bouncy, voluminous salon-blowout hair worn down. Modest, stylish, on-trend clothes. No text, no letters, no logos and no brand marks anywhere unless named below.
hook: Saw this and thought of you
cta: Send this to the one you thought of.
scenes: She sits in the passenger seat of a car in soft afternoon light, smiling warmly into the camera with her head tilted, cozy cream knit sweater.
She sits at a cafe window seat with a latte, smiling at the camera as if she just spotted a friend, golden light through the glass.
She is on an evening walk at sunset, wind in her hair, giving the camera a warm, knowing smile.
She is curled up on a couch under a blanket with a mug of tea, smiling at the camera, soft lamp light behind her.
She sits on a park bench holding a small bunch of wildflowers, smiling at the camera, trees glowing behind her.
framing: Vertical 4:5 frame with generous headroom: soft, out-of-focus background above her head and her face in the middle of the frame. One single continuous photograph, never a collage, split frame or stacked panels. No phone, screen or device is visible anywhere; if it is a selfie, her arm reaches toward the camera out of frame.

entries.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
entries.line: Whatever you are carrying today, you are not carrying it alone.

entries.text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.
entries.line: You are loved more than you know.

entries.text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
entries.line: There is help for whatever today holds.

entries.text: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
entries.line: You won't walk into this week alone.

entries.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
entries.line: You were made for more than fear.

entries.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
entries.line: Peace is closer than it feels.
